This neuron is diffuse/weakly-selective, peaking on the token that continues or completes a noun phrase in descriptive prose — a relative "that" after a noun, the verb after "we will", or the final sub-word of a multi-piece technical term (assay, Coles) — rather than on any single lexical item; it is strongly suppressed on other technical nouns/abbreviations ("app", "RN" in miRNAs, "stainless") and sentence-final periods.

L11·N8469unmasked layer
Fires on ordinary function words (pronouns, auxiliaries, prepositions) inside fluent, grammatically well-formed running prose, and is strongly suppressed on garbled/keyword-stuffed title-like noun strings (SEO spam, mangled citations), so it acts as a "coherent natural sentence vs. noun-salad" detector rather than a specific-token detector.

L11·N11061unmasked layer
